transcript.line: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Ava came back with 415 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 208 kcal in, 207 kcal eaten at the fire.
🌿 Saravanan returns from foraging the wilds: +137 kcal to the pantry — the shelves are full, so 136 kcal is eaten at the fire instead.
🌿 A man, maybe 40s, with ink-stained fingers returns from foraging the wilds: +218 kcal to the pantry — the shelves are full, so 218 kcal is eaten at the fire instead.
Hilda came back with an armful of something edible, unprompted. (+100 kcal pantry)
Ruby came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
Lucas came back with 591 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
